summary: Godfrey’s Falls Church current location-specific Toast surface enumerates 129 distinct products across beverages, morning and day fare, breads, pastries, desserts, retail, and catering. Of 100 frozen rows, 91 match exactly, 2 are menu-heading artifacts, and 7 older brunch or other items are stale on the fully enumerated current ordering surface.
